title: finance-dashboard
text:
Yes to both, and there's a detail worth knowing.

Remote: origin → https://github.com/Atemndobs/financial-dashboard.git. Local main is exactly level with origin/main (both at acb293b), nothing ahead or behind.

The vulnerable code is committed and pushed. All three files in the deleteForeignIncome chain landed together in f7cef02, "Add Swiss tax estimation feature with Lohnausweis import" (2026-04-26), and all three are clean in the working tree. So the bug is not something in your uncommitted work. It has been live on main for about four and a half months.

The repo is public. gh reports "visibility": "PUBLIC". The missing ownership check is readable by anyone.

On actual risk, being accurate rather than alarming: exploitation still requires a valid Clerk session on your instance, since clerkMiddleware blocks unauthenticated requests to /api/*. If you are effectively the only account on fin.atemkeng.com, nobody can currently reach it. The exposure becomes real the moment a second person signs up, and the public source means the path is already documented for them. It also only deletes; it does not read or modify.

What is uncommitted is separate: the tax prep checklist feature, the rules.ts merchant additions, and the tax-dashboard-client.tsx edits. Those have never been pushed anywhere.

Given it is public and multi-tenant by design, I would fix it. Want me to, on a fix/foreign-income-ownership-check branch?
